# FM-1 projects

> Drew Robinson's open-source projects for the M-VAVE FM-1, a tiny hardware synthesiser: ESTAMPIE (custom firmware), FM-SWITCH (an iPhone, iPad and Mac app for swapping firmwares) and FM1Kit (the Swift package for installing firmware that the app is built on). None of them is affiliated with M-VAVE.

All three are on GitHub under github.com/ocean. Installing custom firmware on an FM-1 is at the owner's own risk. This site itself is under CC BY 4.0: reuse it with credit to Drew Robinson.

## Projects

- [ESTAMPIE](https://fm-1.drewr.dev/estampie/): a mediæval groovebox firmware for the FM-1, forked from GHOULBOX and Felucca (GPL-3.0). Source: https://github.com/ocean/estampie
- [FM-SWITCH](https://fm-1.drewr.dev/fm-switch/): a SwiftUI app for iOS, iPadOS and macOS that installs FM-1 firmwares over USB. In development. Source: https://github.com/ocean/FM-SWITCH
- [FM1Kit](https://fm-1.drewr.dev/fm1kit/): a Swift package (MIT) that speaks the FM-1's firmware update protocol over USB-MIDI, installs m-bootloader, and on a Mac backs up, restores and writes the whole flash in the chip's USB download mode. Source: https://github.com/ocean/FM1Kit
